title: Inhalant Abuse (Glue, Solvents & Other Volatile Substances)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from inhalant abuse. Healing from
inhalant dependence is a journey of restoring your physical health, renewing your mind, and rebuilding a
life of purpose and hope. These affirmations encourage resilience, self-compassion, emotional strength,
and healthy decision-making. They are intended to complement professional medical care, counseling, and
recovery support.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Inhalant abuse can cause serious harm to the brain, heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, and nervous system.
Recovery may take time, but healing is possible with professional medical care, counseling, and a
strong support system. Every day you choose recovery is a meaningful investment in your health,
your future, and your well-being.

safety.escalation: Inhalant use can cause sudden medical harm. Seek emergency care for breathing difficulty, collapse, confusion, or suspected poisoning.
